description: This Java class 'FinalPrice' models the price details of a product, including original, discounted, and final prices, along with discount information and potential additional prices.

classes.name: FinalPrice
classes.description: A transient data object used to present various price information centered around discounts and final pricing for products.

methods.name: getAdditionalPrices
methods.description: Returns the list of supplementary price objects associated with this price.

methods.name: setAdditionalPrices
methods.description: Sets the list of supplementary price objects.

methods.name: getOriginalPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the original price before discounts.

methods.name: getDiscountEndDate
methods.description: Gets the date when the discount ends.

methods.name: isDiscounted
methods.description: Indicates whether the price has a discount applied.

methods.name: setFinalPrice
methods.description: Sets the final price after discounts.

methods.name: setDefaultPrice
methods.description: Designates whether this price is the default.

methods.name: isDefaultPrice
methods.description: Checks if this is the default price.

methods.name: setProductPrice
methods.description: Associates a ProductPrice object with this final price.
